subject: Payment path & vendor onboarding — HydraHealth follow-up
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@hydrahealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Payment path & vendor onboarding — HydraHealth follow-up

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the items we discussed that will affect commercial routing: 

- Preferred payment method: your AP team mentioned PO-first for new vendors, but pilot teams sometimes use corporate card.
- Vendor onboarding: HydraHealth requires W-9, insurance cert, and vendor profile creation in Coupa; typical timeline is ~2–4 weeks after docs are submitted.
- Marketplace option: you asked whether Redwood can be consumed via AWS Marketplace — that can simplify procurement but may affect billing cadence and discounts.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I will share a formal quote and a vendor-doc checklist (attached).
2) Can you confirm whether the pilot group can pay by card (one-time CC) or if AP insists on a PO for the initial pilot? This will determine the paperwork path.
3) If PO is required, please share the PO template or the preferred AP contact and ideal lead time so we can align the rollout timeline.

Attached: Redwood quote for pilot + vendor docs checklist.

Proposed timeline:
- Confirm payment method by Wed 17 Feb
- If PO required, target PO submission by Fri 19 Feb; Redwood will begin onboarding upon receipt of required docs.

If it helps, Rishi (cc'd) can coordinate any procurement-level questions and surface options for short-term card payment + later PO conversion.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182
[Attachment: HydraHealth-Quote-Redwood.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: Hydra-Vendor-Docs-Checklist.xlsx (Excel)]

From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@hydrahealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@hydrahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Payment path & vendor onboarding — HydraHealth follow-up

Monica,

Appreciate the summary and attachments — very helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- For enterprise vendors we usually require a PO for any spend over $5k. The pilot budget for this initial proof-of-concept is $4k, which puts it in the ambiguous zone.
- Our AP prefers a PO for anything that will be converted to a contract with ongoing spend, but the pilot can be handled on a procurement card if we treat it as a one-off.
- Marketplace purchases go through a different routing and would require legal review because of data residency attachments. That route may add ~2 weeks to timelines.

Action for us: I will confirm with AP whether they can issue a PO for a sub-$5k pilot (we occasionally make exceptions) and loop in our procurement contact if we need to proceed with card.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 
1) Accept a one-time card payment for the pilot and then convert to PO-based billing if we expand?
2) Start onboarding (e.g., access provisioning) once payment is received, or do you require completed vendor docs first?

Thanks — will get back to you by EOD Wed.

Best,
Aisha Patel
Head of Digital Platform Programs | HydraHealth
aisha.patel@hydrahealth.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: internal: HydraHealth AP constraints & quick options

Team — quick internal note after Aisha's reply: 

- If Hydra's pilot budget is indeed <$5k and AP can allow a card transaction, we should push for that to accelerate time-to-value. Card payment + immediate access is the fastest path.
- If AP insists on PO, expect 2–4 weeks for vendor onboarding (W-9, insurance certs, vendor profile). We should flag any data processing addenda that might trigger legal review — Aisha called out "data residency attachments" which could complicate marketplace purchase.
- Proposal: offer a hybrid path in our quote: 
  * Option A (Fast): One-time corporate card payment, Redwood provisions pilot access within 48 hours of payment.
  * Option B (Procure): Hydra issues PO, Redwood returns signed vendor forms and starts onboarding once docs are verified. Allow a PO-conversion clause to switch billing to PO for expansions.

I'll draft language for Option B that makes onboarding conditional on receipt of the specific docs (W-9 + insurance) so legal/procurement can sign off. Monica — happy to draft the clause and quick FAQ for AP if helpful.

-rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@hydrahealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@hydrahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 10:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Payment path & vendor onboarding — HydraHealth follow-up

Aisha — thanks for the quick turnaround. Based on Rishi's note, proposed mutual action plan below: 

1) Payment path decision (by Wed 24 Feb): Hydra confirms AP stance on sub-$5k pilot (PO vs card).
2) If Card path chosen: Hydra provides card details and Redwood provisions pilot access within 48 hours of payment. No vendor-doc gating for the pilot, though we will still collect W-9 for bookkeeping.
3) If PO path chosen: Hydra to share PO template or PO number by Fri 26 Feb. Redwood will return completed vendor docs (W-9, COI) within 2 business days and start onboarding once AP confirms vendor profile is created. Expected onboarding window: 7–21 days (depending on legal review).
4) Marketplace: If Hydra prefers AWS Marketplace, Redwood will surface the marketplace quote but note that marketplace purchases may trigger additional legal/data residency review and delay provisioning by ~10 business days.

Please see the attached revised quote which includes Option A (card) and Option B (PO + conversion clause). Rishi and I will follow up with a one-page AP FAQ that addresses common procurement questions (W-9, COI, timeline).

Would you be available for a 20-min call Fri 19 Feb at 10am PT to confirm the path? If so, we'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting the pilot started quickly.

Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
